support: Accepted historical local/geodesic support; per-column weighted affine correction
minimum_interface_change: Scalar weights now reproduce reference centroid, instead of load-dependent global force/moment correction; same weights transpose interpolate velocity
power_scope: Exact algebraic virtual power in reference geometry, not physical moving-boundary power or dynamic FSI
units: Pa*m2=N; m cross N=Nm; N dot m/s=W
normal_sign: n_clot points into fluid; positive upper drive gives positive lower-wall tangential force
